about_the_game:
Eɴᴅʟᴇꜱꜱ; Mᴇʟᴏᴅʏ
NᴇMᴇSɪS

𓆩⟡𓆪
"I've tried. So many times I've tried.
And I've failed. Every-single-time.
Is this world truly fated to die? No hope? No happy ending?
...—I refuse." 
✧

•---------•Story•---------•

Silently, and without warning, an eruption from the Ruins of Teralolz tears into the night sky, leaving millions dead, and countless others behind to pick up the pieces of what remains. A fractured, broken world.

A lovable cast of friends and found family are drawn together by design—by Her design. What begins as an ordinary day quickly unravels into something inevitable. Something's stirring. Something's waking up... and it will tear this world apart—forever.

She'll move her pawns with purpose.
No will, no choice.
Only consequence and toll.

𓆩⟡𓆪
"You will be my Angel.
And, you, too, will play your role."
✧

•---------•What to expect•---------•

• A deep, narrative-rich story told within the framing of an RPG.

• Battles are fast-paced. You control your battle leader while the rest of the party fights using Auto-Battle. You can swap behaviors using Paradigm Shifting, or by Swapping leaders mid-fight.

• Unlock character skits throughout the game. These are usually fun little moments for character development, but sometimes, they drop deep, dark lore bombs.

• You're accompanied by an animal buddy who can help out during combat. Also, he has the tude.

• With monsters visible on the map, you decide when and where you want to battle... or not. It's really up to you.

• Features a large ensemble cast. The narrative focus shifts between characters and parties as the story unfolds.

• Achievements build a picture. Nothing major, I just thought it was neat.

name: Endless; Melody—NEMESIS

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel I3 3220 (2012) or newer recommended
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9c / OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU/ 128MB or higher Integraged HD Graphics
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Onboard
  • Additional Notes: Install to an SSD for faster load times
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5, Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU 1GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Onboard
  • Additional Notes: Install to an SSD for faster load times

short_description: The world ends, and so our story begins. Return to the world of Gaia for one last adventure, one final story before it is forever lost beneath the shadows of legends.
